summary: Retest of iteration_2 fixes for TaxSimba Phase 1 enhancement (submission workflow + accountant privacy). Both critical/minor issues from iter-2 are now RESOLVED. Backend: full pytest suite (test_taxsimba_phase1.py + test_taxsimba_phase2.py) — 67/67 pass under both sequential and default xdist+random config. Privacy leak on GET /api/documents is fixed (client_user_id no longer returned to ACCOUNTANT), plus defensive scrub_many() sweep applied to /api/tasks, /api/messages, /api/cases/{id}/activity, /api/cases/{id}/notes, /api/cases/{id}/calculations, /api/cases/{id}/reviews, /api/notifications — verified clean. Full lifecycle (create -> assign -> start-review -> request -> upload -> V1 -> submit-for-admin -> admin return -> V2 -> resubmit -> admin-approve -> client-approve -> READY_FOR_SUBMISSION -> record-submission -> SUBMITTED -> mark-completed -> COMPLETED) passes with activity log carrying previous_status/new_status/comments. All negative paths (record-submission and complete blocked when not in required stage, accountant 403 on record-submission/complete/users/workload/audit-log/other accountants' cases, raw-API stage-skipping rejected, deactivated user 401, client sees only admin-approved calc versions) — all confirmed. Frontend: accountant dashboard now renders exactly 10 acc-tab-* entries (including acc-tab-due_today and acc-tab-due_week) matching the 10 acc-card-* cards; both new tabs clickable and filter correctly ('No cases match this view' on Due This Week for accountant.a with 0 due).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~1000 lines; splitting into routers (cases/submission/documents/super-admin) remains a healthy refactor.
CORS still allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — carry-over from iter-1/iter-2, main agent explicitly deferred (not blocking preview).
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (also deferred by main agent).
PROTECTED_CLIENT_FIELDS includes 'utr'/'address' but no endpoint currently writes them — safe forward-compat.
Defensive scrub_many() is now applied at every accountant-facing list endpoint; consider a single response-model layer or middleware long-term rather than per-endpoint wrapping.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_taxsimba_phase2.py (made TestAuditTrail::test_activity_log_has_prev_new_status order-independent — drives record-submission + complete inside the test if the lifecycle fixture stopped at READY_FOR_SUBMISSION on this xdist worker)

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 acc-tabs + 10/10 acc-cards render and both new tabs clickable)

seed_data_creation: Phase 2 suite continues to spawn ~10 fresh cases per full run (2 lifecycle to COMPLETED with reference HMRC-REF-12345 / HMRC-REF-AUDIT, plus one fresh case per negative-path test for Client B). One TEST_deact_* accountant is deactivated per run. Safe to re-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend for TaxSimba Phase 1 submission workflow and accountant privacy are fully green. If next iteration touches server.py response shapes, re-run `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/ -q` (default runs xdist+random). Frontend regression covered on accountant dashboard tabs/cards; other dashboards (client action card, admin 12 cards, super admin, case workspace 7 tabs) were already verified in iter-2 and testids are unchanged.
rca of the issue: iter-2 fail 'TestAuditTrail::test_activity_log_has_prev_new_status' was order-dependent: the module-level `lifecycle` fixture stops at READY_FOR_SUBMISSION and TestFullLifecycle drove SUBMITTED+COMPLETED. Under xdist loadscope, TestAuditTrail runs on a separate worker where its own lifecycle fixture instance never reaches COMPLETED, so `new_status == COMPLETED` was absent from activity. Fix: TestAuditTrail now drives record-submission and complete inside the test when the case is still at READY_FOR_SUBMISSION, making it independent of test-execution order and worker distribution.
